author: Nahual_Eriol
quote:
Rockstar finally delivered the game progressive activists always wanted: a meticulously crafted simulator of the modern compliant male. GTA 6 isn’t an open-world crime sandbox anymore. It’s an elaborate digital etiquette course where the highest form of gameplay is nodding along, absorbing lectures, and carefully avoiding any action that might upset the correct people.

The most striking design choice is the selective invulnerability. Certain characters and groups are effectively sacred. You can run over civilians, rob stores, and cause chaos in the usual GTA fashion — until the script decides someone is protected. Attempting to treat activists, community organizers, or representatives of approved identity categories the same way you treat everyone else simply doesn’t work the way the series used to allow. The game gently (and not so gently) steers you away. Freedom is conditional. Some lives are more equal than others in Los Santos 2.0.

What remains is a long, expensive exercise in managed rebellion. You get the cars, the guns, the heists, and the satirical veneer, but the satire now mostly points at the player who still expects the old rules. The tone constantly reminds you which opinions are acceptable and which targets are off-limits. It’s less "crime does pay" and more "crime is fine as long as you don’t punch sideways."

The result feels less like Grand Theft Auto and more like a very expensive, very polished compliance simulator with occasional shooting galleries. If you wanted the classic Rockstar sandbox where almost nothing was sacred and the player’s agency was the point, this is not that game. This is the version that politely asks you to internalize the hierarchy before it lets you play. Zero stars.

author: Nahual_Eriol
quote: A wonderful and amazing game. It transfers players to a unique setting and offers them to survive a lot of unexpected situations. Until now, I have never seen so much worked out and consistent with the spirit of the story era. The role component is beyond praise, quests can be performed in countless ways. The combat system is really thought out and interesting. One of the best RPG for all time.
